events.title: Demo Patch 0.2.2
events.summary: Hey everyone! This is a quick one, just a small bug-fixing patch. We've got new content coming soon!Fixed BugsEars not hiding for certain head cosmetics.Cosmetics not sorting consistently.Sprint not getting reset if you sprint into an interactable and use it.

events.title: Demo Patch 0.2.1
events.summary: Demo Patch 0.2.1Fixed BugsAdditional customisation menu controller support.Fixed head clipping for certain head cosmetic items.Fixed multiple bugs when a client is in the customisation menu and the host starts a new game.Removed buggy outlines in the lobby.Forced username to display on one line.Fixed crown displaying at the incorrect position if you joined with a saved outfit.MiscellaneousBalanced spatialization attenuation on Ghost Cats and did a minor balancing pass over all the Fish Heist SFX

events.title: Thank You for 500 Wishlists!
events.summary: It's time to slap your friends! We released our Demo this Monday!!Thank you to everyone who played and wishlisted our game! We've hit 500 wishlists this week, which is awesome! Please leave a review to let us know what you think!If you're looking for people to play with, would like to give us more direct feedback, or just want to hang out and chat, you can join the official RAT TAG! Discord server here!Thank you everyone, and go slap some rats!- David :D
